# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This batch contains a very large number of short WhatsApp/phone snippets. A majority are **internal-ops noise** (attendance, crane/loading, driver coordination, Diwali-gift distribution logistics, bill-copy/invoice handovers, payment-collection follow-ups, "vandi anuppunga" dispatch calls). These were excluded from analysis.

The genuine **sales/enquiry calls** that remain are mostly short, transactional, inbound/outbound telecalling enquiries about **metal roofing sheets and related accessories**, a handful of **screw/fastener** orders, a few **polycarbonate/FRP sheet** and **PUFF panel** enquiries, and some **dealer/field-sales (welding rod) rate & scheme** conversations. Call quality is high-volume/low-depth — most calls are 20–90 seconds, focused on thickness, color, quantity, rate and location, with quotations pushed to WhatsApp. There are also a few rejected/mismatched enquiries (UPVC sheet, liner sheet, 1.2mm MS corrugated sheet) where the rep correctly said "we don't make that." Given the fragment size, this KB stays tightly grounded in only what was said — no invented SKUs or policies.

## Products & brand ladder
Crayon Roofing & Structures (factory: Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai; branch references to Korukkupettai) sells:

- **Metal roofing sheets (color-coated profile sheets)** — core product. Thickness range quoted: 0.45mm, 0.47mm, 0.50mm, 0.6mm.
  - **JSW Color On Plus** — most quoted brand/line.
  - **JSW Pragathi/Pragati** — branded, positioned slightly above Color On Plus.
  - **JSW Radiance**, **JSW Silver On** — alternate JSW lines; rep notes "Silver On கொஞ்சம் விலை அதிகம், JSW கொஞ்சம் விலை கம்மி."
  - **Asian / Indra Dhanush (Asian Force)** — lower/alt brand, AZ 70 GSM, ISI mark, used when customer wants a cheaper option.
  - Color options cited: sky blue, royal blue, off-white/half-white, grey/dark green ("Kali Shelt Green"), terracotta.
- **Tile-profile sheets** — mentioned as a **separate factory's product** ("நம்மளோட இன்னொரு factory-ல tile profile sheet இருக்கு"), not stocked at the Manali metal-sheet unit.
- **PUFF insulated panels** (wall + roof) — 50mm/40mm/30mm thickness; separate factory; quoted per running-meter/square-meter.
- **Polycarbonate / FRP sheets** — thickness 1.5mm, 1.8mm, 2mm (standard, factory-made), and 10mm "clear" (different pricing); **max standard length 15 feet**; custom widths possible, custom lengths not.
- **GI sheets** — distinguished from metal roofing sheet; rep repeatedly clarifies "GI sheet-அ பொறுத்தவரைக்கும் 80 GSM, 120 GSM இருக்கும்" — needs internal confirmation before quoting.
- **Roofing accessories**: L-flash, ridge, gutter, crimp, cutter, barge board — all custom-diagram driven.
- **MS Channels** (JSW brand, e.g., 125/65) — handled via a separate contact/specialist.
- **Screws/fasteners** — Tata-branded self-drilling screws (SDS), rust-free screws, M8 self-welding screws, various sizes (1 inch, 2 inch, 25mm, 55mm), sold by carton/"cotton."
